searchText: My intuition is that they will increase with shorter slot times because there are some things that are valuable to do "each block". There is relatively little in MEV that is valuable "each 12 seconds". There is some (probably most) that is valuable over time (neutral to block time). I've asked this in the searchers channel and their intuition is the same
